# Buffer

> Buffer is a comprehensive social media management platform enabling users to schedule, create, collaborate, and analyze content across 13+ social networks.

Buffer provides an all-in-one solution for social media management, combining publishing, content creation with AI assistance, team collaboration, community engagement, and detailed analytics. The platform supports major networks including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and emerging platforms like Bluesky, Threads, and Mastodon.

## Key Topics

- Social Media Management
- Content Scheduling
- Content Calendar
- Multi-Platform Publishing
- Analytics & Reporting
- AI Assistant
- Team Collaboration
- Content Creation
- Community Engagement
- Cross-posting
- Instagram
- Facebook
- LinkedIn
- X (Twitter)
- TikTok

## Core Features

- [Buffer: Social media management for everyone](https://buffer.com): Buffer homepage showcasing social media management across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn
- [Social Media Scheduler & Planner for Everyone | Buffer](https://buffer.com/publish): Buffer's core publishing feature for scheduling and planning social media content
- [Social Media Content Tools for Effortless Creation | Buffer](https://buffer.com/create): Buffer's content creation tool with AI writing assistance and media organization
- [Social Media Collaboration Tools for Creators and Teams | Buffer](https://buffer.com/collaborate): Buffer's team collaboration tool with approval workflows and permissions management
- [A Focused Space to Reply to Every Comment | Buffer Community](https://buffer.com/community): Buffer Community feature for managing comments and engagement across platforms
- [Social Media Analytics & Reporting Made Simple | Buffer](https://buffer.com/analyze): Buffer's analytics dashboard for tracking performance across Instagram, Facebook, X

## Platform-Specific Tools

- [Schedule Instagram Posts, Stories, and Reels | Grow Your Following](https://buffer.com/instagram): Buffer's Instagram scheduling for posts, stories, and reels with AI assistance
- [Schedule Your Facebook Posts with Buffer | Reach Everyone, Everywhere](https://buffer.com/facebook): Buffer's Facebook scheduling and analytics toolkit for Pages and Groups
- [Schedule Your X Posts with Buffer | Expand Your Reach](https://buffer.com/x): Buffer's X (Twitter) scheduling with planning, analytics, and crossposting
- [Schedule Your LinkedIn Posts with Buffer](https://buffer.com/linkedin): Buffer's LinkedIn scheduling with content creation and analytics toolkit
- [Schedule TikTok Posts with Buffer | Grow Your Following](https://buffer.com/tiktok): Buffer's TikTok scheduling with crossposting to Instagram and YouTube Shorts
- [Schedule Your Threads With Buffer | Grow Your Community](https://buffer.com/threads): Buffer's Threads scheduling for community growth and content optimization
- [Schedule YouTube Shorts with Buffer | Grow Your Channel](https://buffer.com/youtube): Buffer's YouTube Shorts scheduling with content calendar and AI creation
- [Schedule Your Pinterest Posts with Buffer | Drive More Traffic](https://buffer.com/pinterest): Buffer's Pinterest scheduling for photos and video pins with analytics

## Emerging & Decentralized Platforms

- [Schedule your Bluesky posts with Buffer | Build an Authentic Community](https://buffer.com/bluesky): Buffer's Bluesky scheduling for decentralized platforms like Mastodon and Threads
- [Schedule Your Mastodon Posts with Buffer | Make Your Mark in the Fediverse](https://buffer.com/mastodon): Buffer's Mastodon scheduling for decentralized social media in the fediverse
- [Schedule Google Business Profile Posts | Grow Traffic](https://buffer.com/google-business-profile): Buffer's Google Business Profile scheduling for local business growth

## Solutions by Use Case

- [Social Media Management for Creators | Buffer](https://buffer.com/made-for/creators): Buffer's social media solution designed specifically for content creators
- [Social Media Management for Small Business | Buffer](https://buffer.com/made-for/small-business): Buffer's tailored social media management solution for small businesses
- [Social Media Management Tool for Agencies | Buffer](https://buffer.com/agency): Buffer's multi-client management tool for agencies with collaboration features
